pythonFunction.name: retrieve_account_snapshot
pythonFunction.description: Retrieves the customer's complete financial state from the Northwind bank system of record: checking balance, savings accounts with APY, loan accounts with balances and APRs, and recent cash-flow signals. Returns a structured JSON snapshot. Idempotent and safe to retry. ONLY call after auth_status is 'authenticated'. The result is stored in the account_snapshot session variable and used by run_planning_calculation for personalized math.
